Overview

Puntarenas is a city in PU with a population of 120,000. A Pacific port city and beach destination, known for its ferry connections to the Nicoya Peninsula. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.0.
